glosses: homicide (killing of a person by another)
manslaughter (the non-premeditated and/or justifiable killing of another person by another person)

examples.text: Tenho um caso de homicídio a resolver.
examples.en: I have a murder to solve.

examples.text: Tom foi acusado de tentativa de homicídio.
examples.en: Tom was charged with attempted murder.

examples.text: A corte o declarou inocente da acusação de homicídio.
examples.en: The court declared him innocent on the charge of murder.
